apps.name: Summit
apps.description: A native WebKit browser with reader mode, a PDF viewer, extensions, streaming media and developer tools.
apps.note: Install Summit and its matching summit_webkit engine together. airOS packages are below; stock Haiku R1/beta6 has a separate build.

apps.name: AirShot
apps.description: Capture a screen, window or region. Add arrows, labels and markup, then save or copy.

apps.name: AirTime
apps.description: A native movie player with a classic feel and hardware video decoding on supported devices.

apps.name: Amp
apps.description: Your music library, playlists and Music Assistant streams in a native desktop player.

apps.name: Docker Desktop
apps.description: A native dashboard for the airOS Docker Engine: containers, Compose projects, images, volumes, networks and disk usage.
apps.note: Included in airOS system images with the Docker Engine, CLI and Compose. The Engine is an early port: Haiku images run natively, and Linux images run in a lightweight Linux VM with their own namespaces and networks (x86-64).

apps.name: Burrow
apps.description: A native OpenVPN and AWS Client VPN client, including browser-based single sign-on.

apps.name: Clipper
apps.description: A native Deskbar clipboard manager with searchable history, pinned clips and previews for text and images.

apps.name: airImager
apps.description: Write airOS images to USB sticks and SD cards from airOS, checking the download and verifying every byte written.

apps.name: Proton VPN
apps.description: An unofficial native port of Proton’s VPN app: WireGuard or OpenVPN, Secure Core, NetShield, kill switch and port forwarding.
apps.note: Alpha community port, not supported by Proton AG. Requires a Proton account.

apps.name: Proton Mail Bridge
apps.description: Use your Proton Mail account in desktop mail apps through local IMAP and SMTP, with the vault key in the Haiku key store.
apps.note: Community port, not supported by Proton AG. Needs a Proton plan that includes Bridge. x86-64 and ARM64 packages; included in x86-64 system images.

apps.name: WordCraft
apps.description: Write and lay out documents, work with DOCX, review changes and export to PDF.
apps.note: Early x86-64 port with native windows, file panels and clipboard. CPU rendering; native printing and IME composition are not implemented.

apps.name: GridCraft
apps.description: Work with spreadsheets, formulas, charts and XLSX workbooks.
apps.note: Early x86-64 port with native windows, file panels and clipboard. CPU rendering; native printing and IME composition are not implemented.

apps.name: DeckCraft
apps.description: Create PPTX presentations with slides, notes, transitions and a native fullscreen slide show.
apps.note: Early x86-64 port with native windows, file panels and clipboard. CPU rendering; native printing and IME composition are not implemented.

apps.name: PDFCraft
apps.description: Read, annotate and edit PDFs, organize pages and fill forms; includes a command-line tool.
apps.note: Early x86-64 port with native windows, file panels and clipboard. CPU rendering; native printing and IME composition are not implemented.

extra_repos.name: Mail
extra_repos.description: Native email client that replaces Haiku’s Mail in x86-64 images.

extra_repos.name: Kiri
extra_repos.description: Native code editor, Git tools and terminal.

extra_repos.name: AirPins
extra_repos.description: GPIO configuration, pin controls and waveforms for Raspberry Pi.

extra_repos.name: Aurora
extra_repos.description: A native runtime for Electron applications on Haiku.

extra_repos.name: Build tools
extra_repos.description: Haiku cross compiler and build tools.

linux-drm.reason: Imported Linux subset; the version label in CI is not a Git ancestor. Include the complete import and port history.

libdrm.reason: CI records the upstream tag name, which is not published in this fork; use its immutable commit.

hidden_subjects.reason: A retired project is not named on the site: commits whose subject matches are left out of the snapshot and changelog, and check.py fails if a built file matches.
